{{Quote|Major Tierce to Capital Security: full background alert. Possible spies in the city; locate and put under surveillance. Do not—repeat, do not—detain at present. Confirmation from Moff Disra will be forthcoming.|Major Tierce sends an alert to Capital Security|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Capital Security''' was the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agency]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], Capital Security was alerted by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Grodin Tierce (clone)|Grodin Tierce]] that [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] operatives were in the city. Two [[Police officer/Legends|security officers]] spotted the operatives, identified as former [[General/Legends|generals]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. However, Calrissian fired his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] into the ceiling, causing a commotion in the [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] and inducing the crowd to panic. The two officers attempted to locate him but were disabled by Solo.
